self.title: Architectural and Methodological Paths to Reasoning Transparency

detail.title: Architectural and Methodological Paths to Reasoning Transparency
detail.summary: Foundational reasoning axioms are best challenged through architectural separation (decoupling cognition from control) and the deliberate inclusion of dissonance to prevent premature closure on unverified truths. CD-AI frameworks specifically operationalize this doubt.
detail.reason: Revising to integrate CD-AI concepts as a methodology for axiom testing.

children.title: Foundational Axiom Identification in Reasoning Systems

detail.title: Foundational Axiom Identification in Reasoning Systems
detail.question: Can an intelligent system identify a foundational assumption underlying its own reasoning or operation, demonstrate that the assumption is inadequate, and develop a better alternative?
detail.reason: The notebook revision provides a stronger bridge between system-level uncertainty (a measurable output) and the project's goal of identifying inadequate axioms.

detail.title: Synthesis of Cognitive Control and Epistemic Doubt in Reasoning Systems
detail.summary: This journal entry synthesizes research on architectural reasoning control with frameworks for sustaining epistemic uncertainty. Analysis focuses on how Structured Cognitive Loops and Cognitive Dissonance AI can create more accountable, reflective systems.
